description: Technical debt incurred by agents during coding sessions. Deliberately mirrors the structure of feature_list.json so a debt item can be promoted into a feature without being rewritten.

rules.block_session_close_when: any debt with severity "critical" is in status "open"
rules.promotion_rule: A debt with "sdd": true cannot be paid in place. The leader copies it into feature_list.json as a pending feature and sets its status here to "scheduled".
rules.resolution_rule: A debt moves to "resolved" only when every entry in its "acceptance" array is verifiably true, exactly like a feature.

debts.name: example-debt
debts.title: Example Debt — greeting handler has no error-path test
debts.description: While implementing example-feature the implementer shipped the happy path only. The error path (malformed request) is implemented but has no test, so a regression there would pass CI silently. Recorded instead of silently skipped.
debts.interest: Every future change to the greeting handler is unverified on its failure path. Cost grows with each feature that touches it.
acceptance: A test asserts a non-2xx response for a malformed request
The test asserts the concrete error body, not merely that no exception is raised
The test is mapped to an R<n> in specs/example-feature/requirements.md
